item.pong.champagne_bottle.tooltip: Shake while held to build pressure, or open with a champagne sabre.
item.pong.champagne_rack.tooltip: Stores and displays up to four unopened champagne bottles.
item.pong.champagne_sabre.tooltip: Hold with an unopened champagne bottle to pop its cork.
item.pong.debug_rod.tooltip: Development tool for testing champagne racks.
item.pong.goblet.tooltip: Fill from an opened champagne bottle, then drink.
item.pong.plug.tooltip: The cork launched from an opened champagne bottle.
